```yaml
name: FATFS Test

on:
  push:
    branches: [ '*' ]
  pull_request:
    branches: [ '*' ]

concurrency:
  group: ${{ github.workflow }}-${{ github.ref }}
  cancel-in-progress: true

jobs:
  build_and_test_fatfs:
    name: Build and Test FATFS Support
    runs-on: ubuntu-24.04
    timeout-minutes: 10
    steps:
      - name: Checkout wolfSSH
        uses: actions/checkout@v4
        with:
          path: wolfssh/

      - name: Install Dependencies
        run: |
          sudo apt-get update
          sudo apt-get install -y build-essential libtool automake autoconf pkg-config

      - name: Setup wolfSSL
        uses: wolfSSL/actions-build-autotools-project@v1
        with:
          repository: wolfssl/wolfssl
          ref: master
          path: wolfssl
          configure: --enable-wolfssh --enable-sftp --enable-fatfs
          check: false
          install: true

      - name: Configure wolfSSH with FATFS
        working-directory: wolfssh
        run: |
          ./autogen.sh
          ./configure --enable-fatfs --enable-sftp LDFLAGS="-L${{ github.workspace }}/wolfssl/lib" CPPFLAGS="-I${{ github.workspace }}/wolfssl/include"

      - name: Build wolfSSH
        working-directory: wolfssh
        run: make -j4

      - name: Create FATFS Image
        run: |
          # Create a 1MB FATFS image
          dd if=/dev/zero of=fatfs.img bs=1024 count=1024
          mkfs.fat -F 32 fatfs.img

      - name: Create Test File
        run: |
          echo "This is a test file for FATFS integration." > test_file.txt

      - name: Mount FATFS Image
        run: |
          sudo mkdir -p /mnt/fatfs
          sudo mount -o loop fatfs.img /mnt/fatfs

      - name: Copy Test File to FATFS
        run: |
          sudo cp test_file.txt /mnt/fatfs/

      - name: Verify File in FATFS
        run: |
          sudo umount /mnt/fatfs
          sudo mount -o loop fatfs.img /mnt/fatfs
          if ! cmp -s test_file.txt /mnt/fatfs/test_file.txt; then
            echo "File contents do not match!"
            exit 1
          fi
          echo "File verification passed!"

      - name: Test wolfsftp Client with FATFS
        run: |
          # Test that we can use wolfsftp client with FATFS
          # This would require running a test server, but we verify compilation and basic functionality
          ls -la wolfssh/apps/wolfsftp/
          echo "FATFS test completed successfully"
```
